agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on August 28, 2023, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on August 29, 2023.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Renée Amilcar, General Manager, Transit Services Department (TSD) and Michael Morgan, Director, Rail Construction Program presented an overview of the report recommendations and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Pat Scrimgeour, Director, and Scott Laberge, Associate Director, Transit Customer Systems and Planning also responded to questions.
